Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbandonedShipCard, AbandonedStationCard, AbstractEnemy, CombatZoneCard, EpidemicCard, MeteorSwarmCard, OpenSpaceCard, PlanetsCard, StarDustCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract base class representing a card used in the game.

Each card has a unique identifier, a level (1 or 2), and can be activated within the context of a GameModel. Once activated, it can interact with players and fire events using the shared EventDispatcher.

Subclasses must implement the onActivate() method and define their own behavior.

    • activate

      public final void activate(GameModel board)
      Activates the card, binding it to the specified game board. This should only be called once per card instance.
      Parameters:
      board - the game model (board) to bind to this card.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the board is null.
      IllegalStateException - if the card has already been activated.
